text:
deploy-bot: kicking off v2 slice group D at 09:55 UTC. progressive ramp 3% -> 12% over 25m. Note: header normalization + streaming chunk reassembler enabled. Pinlists in effect: tenant-exclude.csv, enterprise-exclude.csv

mike: quick heads up 10 10 does v2 change Accept header parsing? we saw a client that sends uppercase ACCEPT

tara: v2 lowercases header names and trims extra whitespace. Should be fine but one mobile SDK (1.4.1) had a bug that double-lowercases leading to empty content-type in some calls. fixed in SDK PR #483.

sanjay: staging repro: tenant 'velox' saw 502s when stream contexts >8k tokens, boundary reassembly issue triggered on long-polling

ops-jen: monitor alert: velox slice spike to 1.1% 5xx at 10:07 UTC; automated pause fired.

deploy-bot: rollout paused at operator request and traffic for affected slices reverted to v1.

mike: can we pin velox to v1 asap?

rebecca: apply temporary pin via deploy API and add to incident notes.

sanjay: command to pin (ops token required): curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/pin -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${OP_TOKEN}' -d '{"tenant":"velox","route":"/api","version":"v1","reason":"v2 streaming 5xx","expires":"2026-03-28T00:00:00Z"}'

ops-jen: pin applied; deploy-bot acknowledged in 28s. velox 5xx dropped to 0.03% after 3m.

rebecca: ops recommendation: do a targeted hotfix that adjusts stream delimiter handling. Avoid reverting header normalization unless we see broader client impact. SDK team to cut 1.4.2 with the fix.

mike: release notes draft to include: header name normalization (compat note), streaming delimiter change, pin instructions and rollback criteria.

product-liz: product signoff pending for narrow canary to re-run long-context tenants after hotfix bake.

ops-jen: escalation rule reminder: if pinned tenants >7% of canary traffic OR 3 tenants >0.5% 5xx each -> schedule rollback window and page oncall.

rebecca: incident INC-2026-457 opened. assigning to oncall. postmortem placeholder created.

deploy-bot: monitoring update: canary resumed for unaffected tenants, pinned tenants excluded from v2.

tara: ETA for hotfix PR merge and canary redeploy: ~40m if CI green.

mike: OK keep velox pinned and notify tenant success teams to reach out. I'll publish release note blurb and pin instructions.

rebecca: :white_check_mark:
